Title: Public Preview: App Service Minimum TLS Cipher Suite Now on Azure Portal

Body.Content:
Minimum TLS Cipher Suite (Preview) now available on Azure Portal.

To help you improve app security and conformance with your policies, Premium versions of Azure App Service now support specifying a minimum TLS cipher suite for your web apps, through the Azure Portal.   This capability (already available in Public Preview via API) means that you can ensure that weak cipher suites are disabled for your app.

Learn more
